summary: The authors' GitHub repository (CC0) holds in vivo position tracks for upright and inverted organisms (vivo_data.csv, 1,215,040 bytes, Robots 1 to 6, Upright 0/1) together with the simulator and analysis scripts. This contradicts the assessors' obstacle that in vivo tracks are not deposited. Which Robot id is the deciliated cardiac design is not stated in a table I could read.
next_step: Read Transferal_from_silico_to_vivo.py and the paper SI to map Robot ids to designs, then pre-register the heading and displacement tests; regenerate the in silico runs with the Python 2.7 / Voxelyze build.
obstacles_confirmed: Simulated outputs are not stored (results/ is empty); in silico numbers need the legacy Python 2.7 and Voxelyze toolchain.
Design-to-Robot-id mapping must be taken from the code or paper.
